final: WITH group_metrics AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate != 0 THEN (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate END) as avg_relative_gap FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) as baseline_rebate FROM group_metrics) SELECT gm.orderslink, gm.ordertune, gm.avg_rebate, gm.avg_relative_gap, gm.avg_rebate - b.baseline_rebate as excess_over_baseline FROM group_metrics gm CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE gm.avg_rebate > b.baseline_rebate ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
